main_text.l: Joannes de Janduno, Zabarella,& Patres col-
legii Conimbricensis. Nostri instituti non est
Cap. 22. De Memoriâ intellectivâ.
SEquitur Memoria, quæ est principium
intellecta tum conservandi & retinendi,
tum redintegrandi & reddendi.
Theoremata.
I. Memoria est duplex, sensitiva,& intelle-
ctiva. Sensitiva est affixa organo: intellectiva
est inorganica, & ἐξοχὴ[?] quâdam à philoso-
pho vocatur Reminiscentia.
II. Memoriæ intellectivæ duplex est virtus:
retinere fideliter species intelligibiles; & eas,
si quando opus est, reddere promte.
III. Memoria intellectiva nunc est inter-
media inter intellectum & volunta-
tem, nunc sequitur volun-
tatem.

page.notes: The Greek words in the first paragraph (κατὰ μεταφορὰν, λόγον ἐνδιάθετον) and in theorem I (ἐξοχὴ) are as far as I can read them; the last is doubtful. Long s appears as f throughout (e.g. "confervandi", "fenfitiva", "fpecies", "eft", "quasi") and has been normalised to s as the rules require. The ornamental band between the paragraphs and the chapter heading is not transcribed. The "I 5" foot mark is treated as the gathering signature.
